A great quick weeknight dinner is **sheet-pan chicken fajitas**: toss sliced chicken breast, bell peppers, and onions with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, and lime juice; roast at 425 °F for 20 minutes. Serve in warm tortillas with salsa, avocado, and a quick cilantro-lime crema (Greek yogurt + lime zest + chopped cilantro).
